Rosalind is an office manager by title, but the time records show 24 hours a week on job sites directly in charge of the crews: she is not clerical (8810 needs an office away from the operative hazards), and 8810 cannot be divided, so her payroll takes 5645, the class of greatest payroll
Gwen is an estimator who also frames 26 hours a week with the crews: 8742 excludes anyone who does other work of the business, and 8742 is not available for division, so her payroll stays in 5645

Hollin Drywall's only certificate is for general liability, which is not evidence of workers' compensation insurance (Rule VIII(C)(3))

An estimated 50/50 split of Gwen's payroll between 8742 and 5645 is not allowed: no record allocates her payroll, and 8742 is not available for division (Rule IV(F)(2))
